_comment: Single source for the ESP32 <-> web SPA JSON contract: the field names each endpoint emits/reads. firmware/lib/proxy/WebJson.h EMITS these; web/index.html READS them. `python code/scripts/gen_webjson.py --check` fails if either side drifts from this schema (CI: the bridge-parity job). Regenerate the human reference table with `python code/scripts/gen_webjson.py`. This widens the R2 schema-parity idea (ui-schema/bridge.json) to the web-JSON mirror. See web/HTTP-API.md.

endpoints.doc: Nearby meters/trainers for the source picker.
The device's identity/correction config for the SPA to display.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: linear scale baseline (1.0; the ESP uses a curve)

fields.name: has_curve
fields.doc: a fitted correction curve is active

endpoints.doc: The correction curve as portable [power_w, factor] breakpoints.

The #10 A/B meter-compare deep-dive the web Compare card renders: summary + per-torque-band bias + a power×cadence bias grid + downsampled pairs for Bland-Altman. `nested` are the grid's inner keys (checked but not top-level fields); `deltaW` is emitted for head-unit parity and not read by the SPA (js=false).

fields.name: valid
fields.doc: at least one usable pair yet

fields.name: simulated
fields.doc: meter B is fabricated from A (bench adapter) — the numbers restate the ratio, not a measurement

fields.name: deltaW
fields.doc: b-a for the latest pair (head-unit view-model; the SPA doesn't render it)

fields.name: grid
fields.doc: power×cadence bias heatmap; inner keys pW/cLo/cW (axes), P/C (bin counts), bias[][] (null = empty cell)

fields.name: pairs
fields.doc: downsampled [a,b] pairs for the Bland-Altman scatter
